To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The most common reason for parents to enroll their child in an academic enrichment program is to help their child develop academic skills.
The importance of life skills education for children and adolescents is increasingly being acknowledged.

1) Academic skills are more important than life skills for students’ academic success; 2) Academic skills are less important than life skills in terms of the development of students’ life satisfaction; and 3) Academic skills are equally important as life skills for the development of students in terms of their social skills.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to improve the academic and life skills of children in Sri Lankan schools.
the importance of the relationship between academic and nonacademic skills in the context of school success.
how to develop academic skills and life skills in a way that will be appropriate to a child’s stage of development and that will be meaningful to him or her.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
academic skills and life skills are both equally important and should not be neglected.
life skills training is an important part of a child’s development.
the development of life skills should be an essential component of any academic curriculum, as the two are inextricably linked.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the importance of blending academic and Life Skills is a very important one.
it is important for children to have both academic and life skills, and that it is important to blend them together.

the importance of social and emotional learning in school is not a new concept.
academic and life skills are equally important for children to develop and thrive in school, at work and in life.
